title: Oceania source bootstrap seed
description: Oceania batch seed contract. It preserves the shared identity and source selectors while allowing Oceania-owned map and place-selection policy fields.

name.description: Must contain a name after Unicode alphanumeric normalization and match a source city/town name or name:en.

cityOsmRef.description: Selects only among matching named city/town nodes in the verified PBF.

ident.description: Exact unique pinned CSV ident; same-country named airport with scheduled_service=yes required. Municipality may differ.

sourceUrl.description: Caller-reviewed HTTPS source supporting this airport serves the selected city.

hubWaiver.description: Only for a country with no scheduled-service airport: allows its own named heliport or airfield (any scheduled_service) as the game air hub; written reason kept in the receipts.

countryOverride.description: Only for a territory whose airport OurAirports files under another country (Aland AX, EFMA under FI): the named row may carry this OurAirports country instead of the seed's. Not combinable with hubWaiver; the airport point must lie inside the exact territory boundary (batch-run.py); the reason is kept in the receipts.

id.description: Exact unique IANA zone.tab id among rows for countryISO.

sourceUrl.description: Caller-reviewed HTTPS source supporting this city's timezone selection.

profile.description: Selection profile (bootstrap/profiles.json). Absent = standard. microstate: city node may be place=village|hamlet|locality, minimum 12 sourced places and 3 neighbourhood labels, and up to 4 slots without an honest source stay the game's fictional venue (documented in the selection and every receipt). outpost (a station or a few houses: 3 places, 2 labels, up to 9 empty slots, place=isolated_dwelling allowed) and wilderness (a glacier or reef: 0 places, natural names as labels, cityOsmRef required) take the profile-only extraction filters, need no road, never select military or aviation features, may name a gateway and need authored links. Never invents a place or maps a feature to a wrong kind.

gateway.description: outpost/wilderness only, instead of airport: the mapped OSM node that serves as the hub (a landing, heliport or track end), within 40 km of the place; tagged for its mode (air: aeroway heliport|helipad|aerodrome|airstrip; sea: ferry_terminal, harbour, pier, slipway, marina; land: trailhead, mountain pass, saddle, hut, shelter); never a military feature.

timezoneOverride.description: Instead of timezone, for a place whose country has no zone1970 row (Heard Island: Etc/GMT-5) or a user-assigned code: a zone of the pinned zone1970.tab (any row) or Etc/GMT[+-]N; the reason is kept in the receipts.

countryName.description: Only for a user-assigned X? code that the pinned iso3166.tab does not carry (XG Siachen Glacier, XA Ashmore and Cartier Islands).

links.description: outpost/wilderness only (required there): authored links to open cities; the factory adds km and names from the app catalogue and the app applies the outpost fare rule (charter: 1.5 x the air fare, cap 900,000; ship and overland: the road fare on great-circle km). At least one ship or overland link whose fare is at most 100,000 (the feeder allowance), so a homeward quote reaches every home under the 1,000,000 cap. The Lagos connection is added by the app.

waterBudgetLadder.description: Budget-aware water ladder (scripts/geo/factory/water-ladder.mjs). true: when only the scene triangle budget fails, the factory runner repeats the exact-coast stage with a coarser shore (about 2.2 m, then 3.3 m; area error capped at 0.05% and recorded as toleranceLadder). Absent or false: off.

namesUnit.description: Unit label used when presenting local place names.

selectionExclusions.description: Explicit source-derived elements excluded from the generated venue pool. Runtime validation also rejects repeated refs.

countrySourceCityExtract.description: Not a seed field: the country table's countrySource.cityExtract (validated by batch-run.py --validate-only via source-merge.py validate_city_extract; README-batch.md 'City sub-extract'). The admin-0 boundary is built from countrySource.url (plus neighbours); the city metadata and five layers are read from this same-snapshot regional sub-extract.

url.description: Dated official Geofabrik file of the same YYMMDD as countrySource.url; not the primary or a neighbour.

provenanceUrl.description: Runtime additionally requires a hostname and rejects embedded credentials.
